pharmacology.text: C30-NBOMe, or 30C-NBOMe, also known as N-(3,4,5-trimethoxybenzyl)-4-chloro-2,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine or as 25C-NB345OMe, is a serotonin receptor modulator of the phenethylamine, 2C, and 25-NB (NBOMe) families. Its affinity for the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor was similarly low (Ki = 515 nM, versus 0.82 nM for 25C-NBOMe).
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist

uses.text: The drug was encountered as a novel designer drug in Sweden in 2013. The chemical identification of C30-NBOMe has been studied and described.
